candidates.content_text:
Civil Project Engineers — FIFO & Queensland East Coast DTMR Opportunities
Multiple roles | Three established mid-tier civil contractors | Queensland
We are partnering with three respected mid-tier civil contractors to recruit experienced Civil Project Engineers for a strong pipeline of infrastructure work across Queensland. Opportunities include FIFO project delivery and East Coast road and transport projects for the Queensland Department of Transport and Main Roads (DTMR).
The Opportunities
Contractor 1 — FIFO Civil Infrastructure
Join a well-established contractor delivering complex civil works in regional and remote Queensland. This opportunity suits an engineer comfortable working in a site-based FIFO environment and coordinating earthworks, drainage, structures, pavements and subcontractors.
Contractor 2 — Queensland East Coast DTMR Projects
Work on road and transport infrastructure along Queensland’s East Coast for DTMR. The role offers exposure to live-traffic environments, quality and compliance requirements, stakeholder coordination, and the delivery of safe, efficient project outcomes.
Contractor 3 — Regional Roads & Civil Works
Take ownership of project engineering on regional road, bulk earthworks and civil infrastructure packages. This is an opportunity to join a contractor with a practical delivery culture and contribute from planning and procurement through construction and handover.
Key Responsibilities
·        Plan and coordinate daily construction activities, resources and subcontractors.
·        Manage scopes, procurement, cost tracking, forecasting and project reporting.
·        Prepare and administer ITPs, work packs, RFIs, lot records and handover documentation.
·        Monitor programme, productivity and quality against project requirements.
·        Support risk assessments, environmental controls and a strong safety culture.
·        Liaise with clients, DTMR representatives, designers, suppliers and site teams.
·        Identify delivery risks early and drive practical, commercially sound solutions.
About You
·        Bachelor’s degree in Civil Engineering or a closely related discipline.
·        Project engineering experience with a civil contractor in roads, earthworks, drainage, pavements, structures or utilities.
·        Strong understanding of construction planning, quality documentation, cost control and subcontractor management.
·        Clear communication skills and the ability to build effective relationships across site and client teams.
·        A practical, safety-focused approach and willingness to take ownership of outcomes.
·        Australian working rights and a current driver licence.
·        For FIFO roles, the ability to work the project roster and travel to regional or remote sites.
·        Previous DTMR project experience or familiarity with Queensland road construction requirements will be highly regarded.
What’s on Offer
·        A choice of FIFO, regional and East Coast project opportunities.
·        Long-term project pipelines with established mid-tier contractors.
·        Competitive remuneration aligned with experience and project conditions.
·        Career progression through varied, technically challenging civil works.
·        Supportive delivery teams with direct access to experienced project leaders.
Apply Now
If you are a Civil Project Engineer considering your next move in Queensland, submit your CV to info@in2work.com.au and a brief summary of your preferred location, project type and availability. All applications and enquiries will be treated in confidence.

candidates.content_text:
About the role
Silver Yachts Australia is seeking an experienced Fit out Draftsperson / Designer to join our team in Bibra Lake.
 We are looking for someone with strong, practical experience using both Rhino 3D and AutoCAD 2D and 3D, as these are essential to our current design and drafting workflow. You will need to confidently develop detailed 3D models, 2D drawings and production documentation for luxury yacht interior fit outs.
This is a hands-on design and drafting role within our specialised manufacturing environment. You will work closely with our Design and Production teams to develop accurate, practical and manufacture-ready solutions for high-end yacht interiors.
 Key Responsibilities
- Develop detailed 3D models and production drawings using Rhino 3D for cabinetry, joinery and luxury yacht interior fit outs.
- Prepare accurate 2D manufacturing and installation drawings using Rhino 3D and AutoCAD 2D and 3D.
- Develop detailed construction and manufacturing solutions from design concepts and specifications.
- Prepare cut parts, CNC drawings and nesting as required for production.
- Interpret design and technical drawings and translate them into practical manufacturing details.
- Work closely with the Design and Production teams to resolve technical and manufacturing issues.
- Review and update drawings to reflect design changes and production requirements.
- Assist with design development, presentation and visual documentation using Photoshop.
- Ensure all drawings and models are accurate, detailed and suitable for manufacture and installation.
- Liaise with the workshop and production team to ensure designs can be efficiently manufactured and installed.
 About You
We are specifically looking for someone with proven, hands-on experience in BOTH Rhino 3D and AutoCAD 2D and 3D. Both programs are essential to our current workflow, and the successful candidate must be confident using both independently.
 ESSENTIAL SOFTWARE EXPERIENCE: Rhino 3D AND AutoCAD
To be successful in this role, you will have:
- Strong and demonstrated experience using Rhino 3D – this is essential.
- Strong AutoCAD 2D and 3D skills.
- Experience producing detailed 3D models and manufacturing drawings.
- Experience in technical drafting, joinery, cabinetry or interior fit-out.
- Excellent understanding of how designs translate into manufacturing and installation.
- High level of accuracy and attention to detail.
- Ability to interpret technical drawings and develop practical solutions.
- Strong communication and problem-solving skills.
- Ability to work closely with designers, production staff and trades.
- Experience with CNC manufacturing, cabinetry or joinery will be highly regarded.
- Experience in the marine, yacht, architectural, interior or high-end manufacturing industries will be advantageous.
What We Offer
- Full-time position based in Bibra Lake, Perth WA.
- Monthly Rostered Day Off (RDO).
- Opportunity to work on world-class luxury superyacht projects.
- A specialised, high-quality manufacturing environment.
- The opportunity to work on highly detailed and bespoke interior fit outs.
- Supportive and experienced Design and Production teams.
- Competitive remuneration based on skills and experience.
-  
Apply Now
If you are an experienced Draftsperson / Designer with strong, demonstrated experience in both Rhino 3D and AutoCAD, a high level of attention to detail and an interest in working within the luxury superyacht industry, we would love to hear from you.
Please send your resume to hr@silveryachts.com

candidates.content_text:
About the role
You will assist with preparing detailed project quotations and tender submissions for Furniture Fittings and Equipment (FF&E) across major hotel, Build to Rent and hospitality projects. You will work closely with our Senior Estimator and learn Furn-Niche's purpose-built costing systems and estimating processes. Our projects can be complicated. The right person will enjoy investigating the detail, working through large amounts of information and methodically bringing the complete scope together.
Key responsibilities
- Reviewing architectural drawings, furniture schedules, specifications and tender documents
- Finding the relevant information within large construction document packages and tender portals such as Aconex and Procure
- Completing quantity take-offs and identifying missing or conflicting information
- Preparing detailed quote requests for our China estimators and manufacturing partners
- Obtaining competitive pricing from factories and local suppliers
- Quoting custom furniture, joinery, fabrics, finishes and locally procured products
- Building up freight, warehousing, delivery and installation costs
- Working with our designers to understand layouts, materials and design intent
- Working with project managers and installation partners to understand delivery requirements
- Maintaining and improving our estimating database and costing templates
About you
- One to two years of relevant experience or a capable graduate who is keen to learn
- A relevant qualification in quantity surveying, construction management, architecture, engineering, interior design or a related field
- Strong numerical ability and commercial awareness
- Exceptional attention to detail
- A methodical and diligent approach
- The ability to read architectural plans, or a strong willingness to learn
- Confidence working through large and sometimes complicated document packages
- Strong Excel and general computer skills
- Clear written and verbal communication skills
- Experience with estimating, quantity take-offs, construction documentation or tender platforms would be highly regarded but is not essential
About us
Furn-Niche designs, manufactures and installs custom furniture and joinery for hotels and hospitality projects across Australia and New Zealand. Our projects include Mondrian Gold Coast, Elysium Noosa and Avani Mooloolaba, together with almost 100 Quest Apartment Hotels. Our Brisbane team includes estimators, project managers, interior designers and industrial designers. We also work closely with our long-term Furn-Niche China team, which coordinates factory pricing, manufacturing, quality control and logistics.

candidates.content_text:
Project Engineer (Building, Trades & Works)
Riverina Redevelopment Joint Venture (RRJV)
January 2027 Mobilisation Opportunities | Albury-Wodonga & Wagga Wagga Region
Looking for a fresh challenge in 2027?
As many major projects approach completion, now is the ideal time to start planning your next career move.
The Riverina Redevelopment Joint Venture (RRJV), a partnership between CPB Contractors and Downer, is preparing for our next phase of project delivery and seeking experienced Project Engineers - Building, Trades & Works who are interested in joining our team from January 2027 onwards.
This is an opportunity to contribute to one of Australia's largest Defence infrastructure programs, delivering critical facilities across the Riverina region that will support Defence capability for decades to come.
About the Project
The Riverina Redevelopment Joint Venture is delivering approximately $1.7 billion in infrastructure upgrades and replacement works across key Defence establishments, including:
- Albury-Wodonga Military Area (AWMA)
- RAAF Base Wagga (RBW)
- Blamey Barracks Kapooka (BBK)
Project scope includes:
- New accommodation and living-in facilities
- Training and mess facilities
- Building refurbishments and upgrades
- Major infrastructure and services upgrades
The Opportunity
Reporting to the Project Manager, you will play a key role in delivering building and construction work packages safely, efficiently and to the highest quality standards.
We are particularly interested in speaking with Project Engineers who have experience across:
- Commercial building projects
- Defence infrastructure
- Accommodation and residential developments
- Education facilities
- Health and hospital projects
- Large-scale fitout programs
- Trades and finishing packages
- Facades, roofing and building envelopes
- Precast and structural works
- Commissioning and handover activities
You will be responsible for:
- Coordinating subcontractors and site teams
- Managing building work packages from planning through to completion
- Monitoring cost, quality and programme performance
- Resolving engineering and technical issues
- Ensuring compliance with project specifications and standards
- Driving a strong Zero Harm culture across the project
About You
To be successful, you will bring:
- Degree qualification in Engineering
- Approximately 5+ years' project engineering experience within the construction industry
- Strong building construction background
- Experience managing subcontractors, trades and work packages
- Excellent stakeholder engagement and communication skills

Why Join RRJV?

- Attractive relocation assistance available

- Inclusive and diverse workplace culture

Planning Your Next Move?
